ns2:course.label: Advanced Topics in Journalism
ns2:course.description: Advanced special projects, research or reading in journalism at the master's and doctoral level. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in the same term to a maximum of 8 hours. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 24 hours.
